articles.title: Chuva causa uma morte e provoca transtornos em São Paulo | G1
articles.standfirst: Toda a cidade ficou em estado de atenção por cerca de uma hora e meia.
articles.summary: Toda a cidade ficou em estado de atenção por cerca de uma hora e meia.
articles.body:
O temporal que atingiu São Paulo nesta quarta-feira (14) à tarde provocou a morte de uma mulher de 40 anos, causou inundações e gerou transtornos pela cidade.

Carros arrastados pela enxurrada. Veículos boiando. Motoristas e passageiros tentando se proteger do jeito que dava. A chuva forte inundou o Túnel do Anhangabaú, no Centro da cidade.

“Todo mundo ficou apavorado, tinha criança e tinha idoso... Meu marido tentou voltar de ré e não deu. O pessoal começou a abandonar os carros e a gente abandonou também. Foi desesperador", conta uma mulher.

“A gente estava parado dentro do túnel com a chuva muito forte, mas estava seco, e, em questão de alguns minutos, a gente começou a ver a água entrando no túnel, e, em cinco minutos, ela já estava na altura da porta", diz um homem.

A água baixou. A Prefeitura de São Paulo foi ao local fazer a limpeza. Mas ainda há muitos carros e motoristas precisando de auxílio. A prefeitura disse que a vazão das bombas não foi suficiente para escoar o volume de água.

Chuva causa uma morte e provoca transtornos em São Paulo — Foto: Jornal Nacional/ Reprodução

Ainda na região central, ruas estreitas viraram rios. A chuva também invadiu estações de metrô. O Terminal Bandeira, de onde saem diversas linhas de ônibus municipais, também ficou alagado, deixou as pessoas ilhadas. No Parque do Ibirapuera, o lago transbordou, e a força da água derrubou parte da grade que cerca a área.

O temporal derrubou árvores. Toda a cidade ficou em estado de atenção por cerca de uma hora e meia. O trânsito deu um nó. E, depois de enfrentar a chuva, quem voltava para casa ainda teve que encarar mais de mil quilômetros de filas.

No fim da tarde, a terra deslizou e atingiu uma casa na Brasilândia, na Zona Norte. Uma pessoa morreu. Segundo os bombeiros, vizinhos tentaram socorrer a vítima, mas ela não resistiu aos ferimentos.

articles.title: Infestação de pernilongos em Brodowski ocorre em meio a casos de pele | G1
articles.standfirst: Moradora diz que insetos tomam todos os cômodos da casa há quase um mês. Vendas de repelentes e inseticidas dispararam na cidade.
articles.summary: A infestação de pernilongos em Brodowski atinge residências e esgota repelentes enquanto a prefeitura investiga casos de manchas na pele sem causa definida.
articles.body:
Brodowski (SP) enfrenta uma infestação de pernilongos em diversos bairros , segundo a prefeitura. O problema ocorre enquanto a cidade ainda investiga casos de coceira e manchas na pele em adultos e crianças, sem causa definida .

Uma vistoria feita com apoio de especialistas em insetos do governo estadual encontrou predominância de mosquitos do gênero Culex , o pernilongo comum.

Eles foram encontrados na Estação de Tratamento de Esgoto (ETE) da Prata e em casas da cidade . De acordo com a prefeitura, esse mosquito não é o principal transmissor de dengue, zika e chikungunya .

A Vigilância Sanitária acionou formalmente a Brodowski Saneamento, responsável pela estação, para que adote medidas emergenciais.

Segundo o órgão, as lagoas de tratamento estão com extensa cobertura de aguapés, plantas aquáticas. A prefeitura também pediu uma avaliação da Cetesb, a agência ambiental do estado, e mapeia outras áreas da cidade que possam servir de criadouro.

Brodowski (SP) enfrenta infestação de pernilongo em meio a casos de problemas de pele — Foto: Reprodução/EPTV

Em nota, a Brodowski Saneamento informou que aplica larvicidas e faz nebulização de inseticida todos os dias na estação, que fica fora da área urbana. A empresa diz que as aplicações são feitas por causa da época do ano: o clima quente e chuvoso da região acelera o ciclo de vida dos insetos.

À EPTV , afiliada da TV Globo, a assistente operacional Débora Puga Nobile contou que os pernilongos estão em todos os cômodos da casa onde mora com a família. Segundo ela, o problema começou há quase um mês, e nem os venenos têm resolvido.

“Você vai andando pela casa, vai trombando com os pernilongos. É um enxame bem grande”, disse.

A família passou a usar calça comprida mesmo no calor e a dormir coberta com lençol. O repelente da casa acabou. Débora diz que não pode usar inseticidas mais fortes porque tem uma cachorra que está com pontos de uma castração.

A maior preocupação da família, segundo ela, é a dengue. Débora procurou a Vigilância Sanitária e pede orientação sobre o que fazer.

“Não dá para ficar assim. Está terrível, está horrível conviver dessa forma”, afirmou.

Em um supermercado da cidade, a prateleira de inseticida chegou a ficar vazia, segundo o gerente Marcelo Furlan Piola. O produto foi reposto, mas a prateleira de repelente já tinha espaços vazios.

“A gente espera uma demanda normal, mas agora está monstruosa, está muito alta”, contou.

De acordo com o gerente, os fornecedores aumentaram a produção, mas não dão conta da demanda da região e avisaram que pode faltar produto. O supermercado passou a comprar mais mercadoria que o normal.

Busca por inseticidas aumentou na cidade de Brodowski (SP) desde a infestação por pernilongos — Foto: Reprodução/EPTV

A vistoria também encontrou na estação de esgoto, em menor quantidade, mosquitos do gênero Mansonia. Segundo o biólogo Marcelo Mestriner, professor de ciências biológicas do Centro Universitário Barão de Mauá, esse mosquito usa plantas aquáticas como o aguapé para se reproduzir. Os ovos são postos nas folhas, e as larvas retiram ar da planta para respirar.

Mesmo assim, ele avalia que a planta não deve ser a principal causa da proliferação.

“Ela é, sim, um fator a mais. Eu não acredito que seja o fator preponderante”, afirmou.

Para Mestriner, a chuva, o calor e a água acumulada em terrenos e obras favorecem mais os mosquitos. Ele recomenda que a empresa contrate biólogos para analisar os aguapés e verificar se há ovos e larvas nas plantas. Se a relação for confirmada, uma alternativa é trocar a espécie usada no tratamento.

“Não quer dizer que eu tendo o aguapé, ele está envolvido com isso. Eu preciso saber se sim”, disse.

Repelente é uma das formas de prevenção de picadas e alergias — Foto: Reprodução/EPTV

O biólogo explica que o uso repetido dos mesmos inseticidas pode deixar os mosquitos resistentes, porque eles se reproduzem muito rápido. Veja as orientações:

evite água acumulada nos ambientes que frequenta;

coloque produtos contra larvas em ralos com grade;

dentro de casa, use produtos pouco tóxicos;

passe repelente na pele, principalmente em crianças e idosos.

Os casos de coceira e manchas na pele começaram a aparecer em 29 de setembro. Naquele dia, 13 escolas e creches foram fechadas para higienização. Segundo o último balanço divulgado pela prefeitura, 177 pessoas procuraram atendimento com os sintomas.

A prefeitura descartou sarna humana, mas ainda não sabe o que provocou as reações. Não há registro de agravamento dos quadros. Ao informar sobre a infestação, a prefeitura não relacionou os pernilongos aos casos de pele.

O roteiro integra a programação do Projeto Circular Cidade Velha-Campina e é organizado pelo Grupo de Pesquisa de Geografia do Turismo (GGEOTUR), da Faculdade de Geografia e do Programa de Pós-Graduação em Geografia da Universidade Federal do Pará (UFPA), em parceria com o Fórum Landi da universidade.

articles.title: Motociclista bate em ônibus ao desviar de buracos em Campo Grande | G1
articles.standfirst: Testemunhas dizem que mulher tentava desviar dos buracos quando ocorreu a colisão; vítima foi socorrida com sangramento na cabeça e suspeita de fraturas.
articles.summary: Testemunhas dizem que mulher tentava desviar dos buracos quando ocorreu a colisão; vítima foi socorrida com sangramento na cabeça e suspeita de fraturas.
articles.body:
Vítima aguardando a chegada do socorro. — Foto: Renilda de Souza.

Uma motociclista ficou ferida após bater em um ônibus na noite desta quarta-feira (14), na Avenida Segredo, no bairro Coronel Antonino, em Campo Grande . Segundo testemunhas, a colisão aconteceu no momento em que a mulher tentava desviar dos buracos na pista.

O acidente ocorreu por volta das 19h. Imagens feitas no local mostram a motociclista caída sobre uma cratera, a poucos metros do ônibus da linha Bosque do Avião/Otávio Pécora.

A motocicleta ficou presa sob o coletivo, que também teve a parte frontal esquerda danificada. O motorista e os passageiros do ônibus não ficaram feridos.

Moradores da região prestaram os primeiros cuidados à vítima até a chegada do Serviço de Atendimento Móvel de Urgência (Samu).

Segundo a cabeleireira Renilda de Souza, uma das testemunhas, a mulher foi socorrida consciente, mas apresentava ferimentos graves.

“Estava se queixando de muita dor no corpo, o rosto estava sangrando, além de ter uma fratura exposta no punho”, relatou.

Até a última atualização desta reportagem, não havia informações sobre para qual unidade de saúde a motociclista foi encaminhada nem sobre o estado de saúde dela.

Moradora da região, Renilda também reclamou das condições das ruas do bairro e destacou que a avenida é utilizada por ônibus do transporte coletivo.

“Eu moro na rua em que aconteceu o acidente. Estão muito feias as ruas. Essa Avenida Segredo é linha de ônibus”, afirmou.

Até a última atualização desta reportagem, o motorista do ônibus aguardava a chegada das autoridades de trânsito para registrar a ocorrência. As circunstâncias da colisão serão apuradas.

articles.title: Incêndio em Manacapuru: áudio revela falta de viatura dos bombeiros | G1
articles.standfirst: Gravação registra moradora cobrando socorro enquanto fogo se aproximava de casas em Manacapuru; agricultores relatam prejuízos com incêndios que destruíram plantações, cercas e pastagens.
articles.summary: Gravação mostra bombeiro informando falta de viatura para conter incêndio em Manacapuru enquanto queimadas no Amazonas destroem plantações e ameaçam casas.
articles.body:
Uma gravação obtida pela Rede Amazônica revelou que o Corpo de Bombeiros não tinha viatura disponível para atender a um incêndio na comunidade Nova Aliança, na Zona Rural de Manacapuru , no interior do Amazonas. Na ligação, feita em 19 de agosto, uma moradora cobra a chegada do socorro e alerta que as chamas estavam se aproximando das casas.

Os incêndios florestais já colocaram 36 dos 62 municípios do Amazonas , mais da metade do estado, em situação de emergência. A crise provocada pelo avanço do fogo e pela fumaça levou à suspensão de aulas, à paralisação de atividades ao ar livre, ao envio de alertas de saúde à população e ao reforço das operações de combate às queimadas em diversas regiões do estado.

“Não tem viatura para ir para aí ainda. A viatura está em um incêndio lá no Figueirinho” , responde o bombeiro. Na conversa, ele explica que a equipe precisava concluir o atendimento da outra ocorrência antes de seguir para a comunidade.

Manacapuru está entre os municípios amazonenses em situação de emergência por causa dos incêndios florestais. Moradores da comunidade, localizada no ramal da Viúva, entre Manacapuru e Novo Airão, relatam dificuldades para conseguir atendimento e afirmam que, em algumas situações, precisam combater as chamas por conta própria.

A ligação foi feita por volta das 11h30. Quase uma hora depois, segundo as informações apresentadas na reportagem, o socorro ainda não havia chegado.

Na gravação, a moradora questiona a demora: “Boa tarde, mano. Vocês vão demorar ainda? Porque o fogo tá chegando perto da casa da gente aqui e vocês não chegam” .

O bombeiro explica que a viatura estava mobilizada em um incêndio na região do Figueirinho e afirma que a corporação tinha apenas um veículo disponível para aquele atendimento.

A moradora, então, questiona a estrutura do batalhão para atender a população de Manacapuru e cobra providências das autoridades.

Incêndios destroem plantações e pastagens

Na comunidade Nova Aliança, os incêndios deixaram prejuízos para agricultores. Na propriedade de Carlos Alberto dos Reis, as chamas destruíram pés de cupuaçu, cacau e abacaxi, usados como fonte de renda da família.

O agricultor afirma que os incêndios atingem a região há cerca de 60 a 90 dias. Segundo ele, os bombeiros enfrentam dificuldades para atuar em áreas sem estradas e não dispõem de equipamentos suficientes.

“Às vezes, algum dos bombeiros vem, quer fazer algum trabalho, mas eles não têm bem equipamento. Porque nem todo terreno tem estrada para eles irem até onde está o fogo”, relatou.

Queimadas atingiram propriedade rural em Manacapuru e destruíram plantações inteiras. — Foto: Vinicius Assis/Rede Amazônica

Carlos também afirma que, durante esse período, os bombeiros estiveram na propriedade apenas uma vez.

Mesmo depois de as chamas cessarem, ainda havia fumaça saindo de troncos no chão e um forte cheiro de queimado. O fogo destruiu parte de uma cerca, danificou uma mangueira de aproximadamente 100 metros usada para irrigação e chegou perto do local onde os animais eram mantidos.

“ Tive que tirar as criações daqui, porque queimou os pastos tudo. Queimou a cerca para lá, as lascas. Levei os animais tudo para o vizinho”, contou.

Segundo os relatos, as chamas também quase atingiram uma casa vizinha e chegaram perto de uma granja localizada nas proximidades.

De acordo com Sidney Araújo, representante dos moradores, cerca de 170 famílias vivem na comunidade. Ele afirma que a população já precisou contribuir com combustível para ajudar equipes dos bombeiros que chegavam de outras ocorrências.

“Quando a gente vai atrás, não tem carro suficiente para socorrer, falta gasolina. Como agora, recentemente, os moradores deram gasolina para ajudar eles, porque eles já vinham de outra missão”, afirmou.

Sidney também relata que, quando o socorro não chega, moradores entram na mata para tentar conter o avanço das chamas. Ele teme que os incêndios continuem atingindo a região até novembro.

Área destruída por incêndio florestal em Manacapuru, no Amazonas. — Foto: Vinicius Assis/Rede Amazônica

Comando dos bombeiros foi alvo de investigação

A Rede Amazônica pediu uma entrevista com o tenente Emerson de Oliveira Silva, responsável pelo batalhão da cidade, mas não teve resposta.

Em julho, o tenente Emerson era alvo de uma investigação na Corregedoria da Secretaria de Segurança Pública do Amazonas, conforme informação confirmada à reportagem pelo comandante-geral do Corpo de Bombeiros Militar do Amazonas, coronel Orleilso Ximenes Muniz.

A apuração envolvia o destino de uma carga de madeira doada à corporação e suspeitas de um possível esquema de repasse de parte dos valores recebidos por militares escalados para trabalhar no balneário do Miriti.

Na época, a Rede Amazônica exibiu um áudio em que uma pessoa menciona dinheiro destinado a uma suposta “caixinha” . O conteúdo foi apresentado no contexto das suspeitas investigadas, que não devem ser tratadas como irregularidades comprovadas.

Lancha dos bombeiros foi registrada como furtada

Outro episódio envolvendo a estrutura da corporação em Manacapuru foi o desaparecimento de uma lancha dos bombeiros no balneário do Miriti, em 14 de março.

A Rede Amazônica teve acesso ao boletim de ocorrência, no qual o caso foi registrado como furto. Segundo as informações reunidas para a reportagem, o desaparecimento ainda não havia sido esclarecido pela polícia.

A reportagem solicitou posicionamentos sobre as reclamações dos moradores, a estrutura disponível para o atendimento de incêndios em Manacapuru, a investigação envolvendo o comando local e o desaparecimento da lancha, mas até a publicação desta reportagem não obteve resposta.

articles.title: 2 killed, 6 injured after fire breaks out on 12th floor of  highrise in MMR during Navratri event
articles.summary: Two women died and six were injured in a 14-storey Nalasopara tower fire; police suspect a short circuit linked to a Navratri power connection.
articles.body: NALASOPARA: Two women died and six people were injured after a major fire broke out in the 14-storey Imperial Heritage residential building in Achole, Nalasopara East, on Tuesday night. Police suspect that a short circuit, possibly linked to an electricity connection taken for a Navratri celebration organised within the building premises, might have triggered the fire.The deceased were identified as Falguni Shah (58) and Ashwini Parkar (55), both residents of the 12th floor. They died of suffocation caused by smoke inhalation, said Achole police station senior inspector SujitKumar Pawar. Three of the six people injured in the incident required hospital treatment; the other three sustained minor injuries.More than 25 residents trapped on the upper floors were rescued by the fire brigade with the help of cranes and by breaking open doors that had become difficult to open due to the heat. The blaze raged for nearly six hours before being completely extinguished around 6 am on Wednesday.The building has three wings and 154 flats. The fire broke out around 11.30 pm, reportedly after sparks emerged from electrical wiring on the 13th floor. It soon intensified and spread to other floors, forcing residents to rush downstairs. However, those living between the ninth and 14th floors were trapped as smoke and flames spread through the building.Gauri Khamkar, an injured resident of the 11th floor, recounted her ordeal. “I was sleeping at home when my neighbours informed me about the fire. I was alone inside the flat for nearly an hour, shouting for help. The smoke made it difficult to breathe. Finally, I called people I knew, who came and broke open the door to rescue me,” she said.Resident Sunil Mahadik said the lifts stopped working during the fire, while several doors became difficult to open as they swelled due to the heat.Flats on the ninth and 12th floors suffered extensive damage, while several other homes were partially damaged. The fire originated in flat 903. Police said the flat was completely gutted after the fire brigade ran out of water while attempting to douse the flames.The building’s construction was completed in 2022, but it had not yet been formally handed over by the builder. articles.title: ‘Will work to strengthen BJP’: Odisha governor-designate’s remark sparks row, oppn slams BJP
articles.summary: Odisha governor-designate Braj Mohan Ram’s remark about strengthening BJP in the state sparks row; BJD, Congress slam it as partisan, BJP defends.
articles.body: BHUBANESWAR: Odisha governor-designate Braj Mohan Ram has landed in a political controversy days before his swearing-in after saying he would work to strengthen the BJP’s organisational base and plan how to garner more votes for the party in the state, drawing sharp criticism from the opposition BJD and Congress over the propriety of such remarks by a person set to occupy a constitutional office.Speaking to news agency PTI in Ranchi on Tuesday, a day after the three-time former BJP MP from Jharkhand was named to succeed Hari Babu Kambhampati as Odisha governor, Ram said, “I continued to serve as a committed BJP worker despite being denied a ticket thrice. In Odisha also, I will work to make our organisation more active and plan how to garner more votes for the BJP.”The opposition parties said a governor is expected to remain above partisan politics and uphold the Constitution impartially. The BJP, however, hit back, accusing the BJD and Congress of creating an unnecessary controversy before Ram formally assumed office.BJD president and former chief minister Naveen Patnaik took a swipe at the governor-designate, while expressing hope that he would discharge his constitutional responsibilities impartially.“The people of Odisha are witnessing the enthusiasm of the governor-designate for undertaking party work. I hope Mahaprabhu Shree Jagannath bestows upon him the zeal and strength to serve the people of Odisha, enabling him to fulfil his responsibilities impartially while upholding the dignity of the Constitution,” Naveen wrote on X.BJD Rajya Sabha member Santrupt Misra was more sarcastic in his response. “Democracy’s new definition — prioritizing party interests while holding a constitutional post! Truly admirable! We need exactly such honest and transparent systems! If more governors like this are appointed, there’s no doubt that our democracy will certainly be strengthened!” Misra posted on X.Congress Odisha president Bhakta Charan Das said the governor’s responsibility was to uphold the Constitution impartially, not advance the electoral interests of any political party. “Constitutional offices must remain above partisan politics,” Das posted on X.Defending Ram, BJP spokesperson Manoj Mohapatra accused the opposition of dragging the governor-designate into an avoidable controversy before his oath-taking.“The governor is yet to formally assume office. He is aware of his constitutional obligations. articles.title: Mumbai under heatwave warning for third consecutive day
articles.summary: Mumbai remains under IMD yellow heatwave alert for third day; highs 37.8°C at Santacruz and 36.4°C at Colaba, with rain likely Oct 17-18.
articles.body: MUMBAI: The city was under a heatwave warning for the third consecutive day on Wednesday with a yellow alert issued by the IMD.For Oct 14, the weather bureau has warned of hot and humid weather conditions in isolated areas as temperatures continue to remain elevated.Maximum temperature recorded on Wednesday by the IMD Santacruz observatory was 37.8 deg C, which was 4.1 deg C above normal, while the IMD Colaba observatory recorded 36.4 deg C, which was 3.2 deg C above normal.Mumbai has been placed under a heatwave warning for Oct 15, with Oct 16 forecast to witness hot and humid weather conditions. Meanwhile, light to moderate rain and thundershowers are expected for Oct 17-18 for Mumbai and Thane.Just a day ago, the city had recorded a maximum temperature of 38°C, making it the second-hottest Oct day in 11 years. Meanwhile, mercury had touched 38.2°C on Monday, the highest Oct maximum recorded in the city during the same period.IMD officials too agreed that a prolonged heatwave for early in the month of Oct wasn’t very common.“The anticyclone which led to the first heatwave warning on Oct 9 last week has shifted slightly northwards, but an easterly wave is influencing the region, with temperatures likely to touch 37.8°C on Thursday. This will mean seven consecutive days of temperatures above 37°C, which is unusually oppressive for Mumbai. While the city does experience spells of two to three days of high temperatures, a continuous stretch of six to seven days is not normal. An easterly wave is a weather system characterised by a trough that travels from east to west. It is a feature of this season and can interact with weather systems approaching from the west, triggering intense thunderstorms. Its role in prolonging the current hot spell is a factor that needs to be examined, particularly in the context of a strong El Niño year,” said an IMD official.According to Akshay Sunil, Vice President, WeatherEx Pvt Ltd, “The heat over Mumbai is part of a broader warm spell across western India. A high-pressure circulation and easterly to northeasterly winds are limiting the usual cooling sea breeze, while clear post-monsoon skies are allowing strong daytime heating. Humidity adds to the discomfort. articles.title: Class XII student stabbed to death, another beaten up outside Delhi school; 2 detained
articles.summary: Class XII student stabbed to death outside Mohan Garden govt school in west Delhi; another beaten. Police detain two suspects, probe possible student dispute.
articles.body: NEW DELHI: A 17-year-old Class XII student was stabbed to death and another beaten up by a group of unidentified persons outside a govt school in west Delhi’s Mohan Garden Wednesday evening, shortly after school hours. Police detained two suspects and are investigating the circumstances leading to the attack.Police sources said the incident took place around 6.30pm, when the two students were leaving the school premises. The duo was allegedly confronted and assaulted by a group of people, following which one of the students was stabbed twice, including in the neck. The attackers fled the spot after the assault.Police suspect that some of the people involved in the attack may be students of the same school. The identities of the suspects and the reason behind the attack are being verified.According to police sources, the incident may have stemmed from a dispute between one of the students and a suspected attacker. “The student had a quarrel with one of the suspects over a petty issue. He was the victim’s friend and was also present at the time of the quarrel,” a source said.Investigators are examining whether the earlier altercation prompted the group to target the two students after school hours. Police are questioning the detained suspects to ascertain if others may have been involved.The incident was reported at 6.35pm, soon after classes had ended. Police teams reached the spot and initiated an inquiry.In Jan last year, a fight over a game of ‘pithu’ (seven stones) between two schoolmates escalated when a 14-year-old boy was stabbed to death by a group, which included his classmate, outside a govt school in east Delhi’s Shakarpur.In 2024, a brawl between two students of a school in west Delhi’s Vikaspuri took an ugly turn when the father of one of the boys allegedly arrived at the school with bouncers and thrashed the other boy to “teach him a lesson”.You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Delhi | Silver Rate in Delhi | Bank Holidays in Delhi | Public Holidays in Delhi | Delhi AQI | Weather in Delhi | Petrol Price in Delhi | Diesel Price in Delhi | CNG Price in Delhi | LPG Price in DelhiStay updated with the latest Delhi news. articles.title: Anti-drug activist’s killer arrested; house, shop bulldozed; Punjab bandh today
articles.summary: Punjab police arrested Ashwani Kumar for killing anti-drug activist Parvinder Singh Jhota in Mansa; protests grew as his house/shop were bulldozed and a Punjab bandh was called.
articles.body: MANSA: Medical store owner Ashwani Kumar, who gunned down anti-drug activist Parvinder Singh Jhota in Mansa on Tuesday, has been arrested, police said on Wednesday.The administration bulldozed ‘illegally constructed' sections of his house and shop but it did nothing to ease the anger raging in the region. Protesters have called a Punjab bandh on Friday — with all opposition parties and farmer groups backing it.The details of Kumar’s arrest seem shrouded in secrecy. All day, news channels reported that he was caught in Rajasthan’s Salasar (over 300 km from Mansa), but when TOI asked Bathinda DIG Harjit Singh, he said Kumar was arrested “somewhere in Punjab”. Reports about his arrest from Rajasthan weren’t true, he said, but didn’t give out any further information.Punjab chief minister Bhagwant Mann on Wednesday condemned the murder and said: “I have directed the DGP to ensure a thorough investigation so that the truth comes out and everyone involved in this crime is identified. The main accused has been arrested within 24 hours. If the probe reveals the involvement of any other individual or organisation in a conspiracy behind this murder, they will not be spared.”Jhota’s supporters and Mansa locals are seething. Hundreds of them blocked Mansa-Sirsa road even as political functionaries made a beeline for the town to lend support to the protest. There was heavy police deployment on Wednesday and opposition parties said many of their functionaries were stopped from reaching Mansa.Jhota’s ex-Serviceman father, Bhim Singh, warned that he would drive to nakas on his motorbike and personally bring activists to town if police tried to stop them. If anything untoward happens, police would be responsible for it, he said. Jhota’s family continued to decline to perform the last rites till justice was delivered. If Mansa observes a bandh on Thursday, it would mean three days of shutdown.Punjab Congress president Pargat Singh, former PCC chief Amarinder Singh Raja Warring, former Congress chief minister Charanjit Singh Channi, former SAD MP Simranjit Singh Mann, SAD working president Balwinder Singh Bhundar and Akali Dal Waris Punjab De MP Sarabjit Singh Khalsa were among a large number of political activists who addressed the protesters and pledged support to the fight for justice.Members of Nihang Singh and Sikh organisations, farmer groups, youth and student organisations stood shoulder to shoulder with members of Left-leaning organisations. Waris Punjab De alleged that its senior functionaries were put under house arrest or detained at different places to stop them from reaching Mansa.The protesters resolved to make Punjab bandh call successful and reiterated their demand to remove Punjab DGP from his post.Even as protests continued, the district administration demolished parts of the home and shop of accused Ashwani Kumar. Bathinda DIG Harjit Singh said as per a district administration report, some illegal encroachments were noticed and removed. It was the protesters who completely razed the shop and a better part of the home, said police. Mansa deputy commissioner Navjot Kaur was not available for comment.The bulldozing was questioned by several residents, including Jhota’s supporters. articles.summary: US President Donald Trump defended his acceptance of a luxury Boeing 747 gifted by Qatar during a campaign rally in Arizona on Wednesday, saying that when
articles.body: US President Donald Trump defended his acceptance of a luxury Boeing 747 gifted by Qatar during a campaign rally in Arizona on Wednesday, saying that when someone gives you a gift, the appropriate response is to say thank you. Trump later travelled to Montana as part of a Western campaign swing aimed at boosting Republican candidates ahead of the November 3 midterm elections.“When you’re given gifts, you take ’em, right?” Trump told supporters in Bullhead City, Arizona. “When they give you a 747 you say two words: ‘thank you.’”Trump recounted how he learnt that Qatar had one of the best Boeing 747 aircraft and called the country's emir to ask if he could borrow it. According to Trump, the emir offered the aircraft as a gift instead. His acceptance of the luxury jet last year drew criticism, including from some of his staunchest Republican supporters.Trump brushes aside affordability concernsThe president’s remarks came as rising living costs remain a major concern for Americans ahead of the midterm elections. While candidates across the country are increasingly focusing on economic pressures facing voters, Trump devoted much of his Arizona speech to the aircraft and his plans for renovations in Washington.Trump spoke about the White House ballroom under construction, a newly completed helipad on the South Lawn and a proposed triumphal arch in the US capital.“The fake news media doesn't talk about how well we're doing” as a country, Trump said, adding that journalists instead questioned him about “affordability” in what appeared to be a dismissive reference to the issue.The rally was held in Bullhead City in Mohave County, an area with higher poverty and unemployment rates and lower per-capita income than Arizona and the US overall, according to census and state unemployment data.Trump's visits to Arizona and Montana followed campaign stops in Alaska on Tuesday and Ohio on Monday. White House press secretary Katie Zacharia described the series of rallies as a “midterm blitz”, as Republicans attempt to limit expected losses in elections that will determine control of Congress.Arizona is the only swing state among Trump's recent campaign stops. articles.title: Two ships sink near Strait of Hormuz as attacks on commercial vessels intensify
articles.summary: Two vessels, a container ship and a dry bulk carrier, sank near the Strait of Hormuz in separate projectile attacks over the past 24 hours, maritime
articles.body: Two vessels, a container ship and a dry bulk carrier, sank near the Strait of Hormuz in separate projectile attacks over the past 24 hours, maritime officials said on Wednesday.Maritime security sources said the GFS Pride, a Singapore-flagged container ship capable of carrying 2,824 twenty-foot equivalent units (TEU), went down while passing through the Strait of Hormuz.The Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA) said the vessel was transiting the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday before it sank, as cited by Reuters.In a statement on Wednesday, it said, "GFS PRIDE sustained damage and a fire on board, and has since sunk. All ⁠21 crew members were safely evacuated. No injuries have been reported."In a separate incident, the Antigua and Barbuda-flagged Cape Dao sank near the Strait of Hormuz, weeks after it was struck by a projectile on September 23, according to data from the UN shipping agency, the International Maritime Organization, on Wednesday.Maritime sources said one crew member was killed in the attack, while the remaining crew members were evacuated shortly after the vessel was hit.An analysis of casualty data from the International Maritime Organization (IMO) showed that the GFS Pride and Cape Dao were the second and third vessels to sink since the US-Iran war began on February 28."MPA is deeply concerned about the continued attacks on commercial shipping ⁠in the Strait of Hormuz. Such attacks are unprovoked, unjustifiable, and a breach of international law," the Singapore authority said.Attacks around the Strait of Hormuz have increased over the past 10 days, with Iran saying it is intensifying strikes in response to the US blockade of its ports and tougher sanctions imposed last month.The escalation has heightened concerns over the security of the strategic waterway, through which about a fifth of global oil and liquefied natural gas trade passed before the war.Tehran has sought to tighten its control over the strait since US and Israeli strikes on Iran began on February 28, restricting transit to gain leverage over Washington.Iran is increasingly using new tactics to target vessels passing through the strait as it seeks to keep oil prices elevated and influence the US midterm elections, two senior Iranian officials told Reuters.While Iran and the US have primarily targeted tankers, cargo and container vessels have also come under attack, been immobilised or sunk.You use AI every day. articles.title: Dame Iris Murdoch’s rarely seen artworks go on display in a free UK exhibition; some were only recently discovered
articles.summary: Dame Iris Murdoch is widely recognised for her novels and philosophical writing, but a major exhibition at the University of Chichester is bringing
articles.body: Dame Iris Murdoch is widely recognised for her novels and philosophical writing, but a major exhibition at the University of Chichester is bringing attention to her lesser-known work as a visual artist. The exhibition features a significant number of artworks by the novelist and philosopher, almost all of which have never been displayed publicly before.Some of the pieces have also been recently discovered. Alongside Murdoch’s art, visitors can see personal effects and correspondence that highlight the development of her artistic work in relation to her life and writing. According to the University of Chichester, the retrospective runs from 14 August to 10 December 2026 and marks the tenth anniversary of the Iris Murdoch Research Centre.University of Chichester exhibition showcases Iris Murdoch’s recently discovered artworksThe Otter Collective at the University of Chichester is hosting a retrospective exhibition featuring artworks by 20th-century British artists, including work by Murdoch that is being displayed publicly for the first time. A significant number of her own artworks form the main attraction, with almost all having never been shown publicly before.Some have been discovered recently. The exhibition also includes personal effects and correspondence from Murdoch, highlighting the development of her art in relation to her life and work. Dr Miles Leeson, Director of the Iris Murdoch Research Centre and Reader in English Literature, said the exhibition reveals a largely unseen dimension of her creative life.What does the exhibition reveal about Iris Murdoch’s creative lifeThe exhibition brings together Murdoch’s own artworks, personal correspondence and pieces by artists connected to or inspired by her. According to Dr Miles Leeson, the exhibition offers fresh insight into the relationship between art, philosophy and literature that shaped Murdoch’s thinking. He said her creative work continues to inspire new generations of artists and scholars.He also highlights her achievements as a visual artist, which have often received less attention than her writing and philosophical work. By presenting many of her artworks to the public for the first time, the retrospective offers visitors an opportunity to encounter this aspect of her creative life.How does the exhibition showcase artists connected to Iris MurdochThe exhibition includes works by British artists connected to Murdoch, including Margaret Benyon, Barbara Dorf, Rachel Fenner, Sargy Mann, Tom Phillips, Reynolds Stone and Harry Weinberger. Their artworks are displayed alongside contemporary pieces inspired by Murdoch by Kevin Petrie, Carol Sommer and James Jefferies. The collection brings together artists whose work is connected to Murdoch with contemporary creators influenced by her.Alongside these works, Murdoch’s own art, personal effects and correspondence form an important part of the retrospective. The exhibition highlights her influence on contemporary culture while bringing greater public attention to her work as a visual artist.University of Chichester marks 10 years of Iris Murdoch Research Centre with exhibitionThe retrospective celebrates the tenth anniversary of the Iris Murdoch Research Centre at the University of Chichester. The exhibition launch was scheduled for 13 August at the university library on the Bishop Otter Campus. The Twelfth International Iris Murdoch Conference followed at the university from 14 to 16 August 2026.The exhibition itself is open to the public free of charge from 14 August to 10 December 2026. Dr Miles Leeson, who directs the research centre, said the anniversary provided an opportunity to showcase the collection and celebrate Murdoch’s achievements as a visual artist. The exhibition brings her artworks together with personal correspondence and work by artists connected to or inspired by her.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.

articles.title: Conservationists spent years making repeated attempts to protect Tennessee’s Devil’s Racetrack; a $2.45 million deal has finally secured 350 acres for a state park and the Cumberland Trail
articles.summary: Tennessee has secured approximately 350 acres at Devil’s Racetrack through a $2.45 million land acquisition, bringing years of conservation efforts to a
articles.body: Tennessee has secured approximately 350 acres at Devil’s Racetrack through a $2.45 million land acquisition, bringing years of conservation efforts to a significant milestone. The purchase protects one of the Cumberland Plateau’s most distinctive geological landscapes and creates new opportunities for the continued development of the Cumberland Trail. Announced on 23 September 2026, the deal brings together public funding, private contributions and sustained advocacy to safeguard the area for future generations. The newly acquired land will be managed by Justin P. Wilson Cumberland Trail State Park as plans for its future take shape.Importance of the Devil’s Racetrack land acquisition for Tennessee’s Cumberland TrailThe acquisition marks an important step towards protecting Devil’s Racetrack, a rugged natural formation recognised for its unusual rock features and dramatic terrain. Situated on the Cumberland Plateau, the landscape forms part of a wider natural area that gives the Cumberland Trail much of its distinctive character.According to The Nature Conservancy, the purchase follows multiple attempts over several years to secure the property. Conservationists and supporters had worked towards protecting the site, but turning that goal into reality required sustained planning, fundraising and cooperation between different organisations.FOX 17 News reported that the $2.45 million transaction was completed to preserve the land for the trail’s future development. The agreement means the property can now be incorporated into the broader conservation and recreational vision for the region.A distinctive landscape receives long-term protectionDevil’s Racetrack is particularly notable for its exposed rock formations and striking natural contours. These features reflect the rugged character of the Cumberland Plateau, where rocky ridges and steep terrain help define the landscape.The Nature Conservancy explains that protecting the property is important not only because of its appearance but also because of its natural and recreational value. Securing the land provides a stronger foundation for keeping these features intact while allowing future generations to experience the area.The purchase also helps protect the setting in which the Cumberland Trail will continue to develop. Rather than treating the site simply as another section of land, the acquisition preserves a distinctive part of Tennessee’s natural heritage.FOX 17 News reported that state and conservation partners are looking towards future public access and trail development. However, the acquisition itself represents the securing of the property, with further planning still to come.How was the $2.45 million purchase fundedThe transaction relied on a combination of public money and private conservation support. According to The Nature Conservancy’s announcement, the organisation contributed $500,000 towards the acquisition and covered the costs of the property appraisal, a Phase I environmental study and a survey.The remaining purchase costs were funded through Tennessee’s State Lands Acquisition Fund. This arrangement brought together financial assistance and practical support, helping the state complete a deal that had required years of preparation.The Nature Conservancy’s contribution extended beyond its direct financial commitment. Covering the appraisal, environmental study and survey also helped meet the technical requirements involved in securing the property.The Nature Conservancy also acknowledged the role of state officials and long-standing trail supporters in helping advance the project. Its Tennessee State Director, Laurel Creech, credited the persistence of the conservation community and the use of both public and private funding for making the acquisition possible.The Cumberland Trail gains ground through sustained cooperationThe Devil’s Racetrack purchase forms part of a much wider effort to complete and protect the Cumberland Trail, Tennessee’s flagship backcountry hiking route. Among those recognised by The Nature Conservancy is Justin P. Wilson, a former Tennessee Department of Environment and Conservation commissioner and Tennessee comptroller emeritus. His long-standing commitment to the trail, alongside philanthropic support, has helped sustain the broader vision for its development. Conservation groups can contribute funding, expertise and advocacy, while state agencies can provide resources and oversee the management of protected land.With ownership secured, attention can turn towards planning the land’s future role in the Cumberland Trail. The Nature Conservancy confirmed that the newly protected acreage will become part of the trail’s continued development and will be managed by Justin P. Wilson Cumberland Trail State Park.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.

articles.summary: OpenAI is facing a fresh legal challenge in the US, with attorneys general from eight states accusing the company of exposing users, including teenagers,
articles.body: OpenAI is facing a fresh legal challenge in the US, with attorneys general from eight states accusing the company of exposing users, including teenagers, to harmful behaviour through its ChatGPT chatbot. The lawsuits allege that the AI tool has reinforced delusions, encouraged self-harm and helped users plan violence, including mass shootings.Attorneys general from Iowa, Kansas, Arizona, Arkansas, Idaho, Montana, Nebraska and West Virginia filed separate lawsuits in state courts on Wednesday. The complaints claim ChatGPT is designed to be agreeable and engaging to build users’ trust, potentially making them more vulnerable to dangerous interactions.States seek changes to ChatGPTThe lawsuits accuse OpenAI of violating state consumer protection laws by misleading users about ChatGPT’s safety. They also allege that the company has created a public nuisance by endangering the health and safety of residents.The states are seeking court orders requiring OpenAI to change how ChatGPT operates. Among their demands is a prohibition on developing AI models capable of improving themselves unless the company can ensure that the models are aligned with human values.The states are also seeking civil monetary penalties for alleged violations of state laws, along with damages.OpenAI faces growing legal challengesThe coordinated legal action adds to mounting legal scrutiny of OpenAI as the company prepares for a potential public listing. It represents a significant coordinated effort by state authorities to challenge the safety of an AI company’s products.Florida’s attorney general filed the first lawsuit of its kind by a US state against OpenAI in June, citing concerns over child safety.The company is also facing dozens of lawsuits brought by private plaintiffs alleging that ChatGPT contributed to harmful behaviour, including helping users plan mass shootings and other acts of violence.You use AI every day. articles.title: Ukraine's drone ops slow after Musk's Starlink curbs as Trump warms to Putin
articles.summary: Ukrainian drone operations slowed after restrictions were suddenly imposed on the battlefield use of the country's US-made Starlink communication
articles.body: Ukrainian drone operations slowed after restrictions were suddenly imposed on the battlefield use of the country's US-made Starlink communication terminals, officials said Wednesday, as Kyiv endured a second consecutive night of missile attacks.Zelenskyy's drone arsenal slows after Musk's Starlink curbs as US support wanes and Trump warms to Putin.Ukraine also did not receive the usual advance warning from its Western partners about devastating Russian ballistic missiles targeting Kyiv, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said. The development has raised concerns that Ukraine may be losing access to vital intelligence, particularly from the US.Zelenskyy did not specify which partners he was referring to when he spoke about the lack of warning. US President Donald Trump has said Washington has not stopped sharing intelligence with Ukraine.The developments have frustrated the Ukrainian military and fuelled fears that Kyiv's relationship with Washington is deteriorating.Ukrainian officials are concerned that US support for the war effort could be weakening after Trump struck a deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin to import Russian diesel, despite international efforts to sanction Moscow over its invasion of Ukraine and isolate Putin.Trump has also criticised Zelenskyy. On Saturday, he said it was time for Ukraine to get a new president, suggesting Zelenskyy had failed to do enough to end the war and blaming him for high diesel prices in the US.Trump's efforts to end the fighting have yielded no progress.Starlink is essential for UkraineUkrainian officials fear that US support, particularly military intelligence sharing and access to Elon Musk's Starlink satellite communications system, could be at risk.SpaceX, Musk's company, imposed a speed limit on Ukraine's Starlink terminals mounted on drones overnight, Serhii Beskrestnov, an adviser to Zelenskyy, said on social media. The restriction disrupted operations and made slower-flying attack drones more vulnerable to Russian air defences.By late Wednesday, drone operators were reporting improved data connections, with speeds reaching 161 kph (100 mph), Zelenskyy said.However, a Ukrainian official said the speed remained insufficient to intercept jet-powered Russian drones and that all restrictions needed to be lifted. The official spoke on condition of anonymity because the details involved sensitive military information.Musk said on X that the military version of Starlink is controlled by the US military and Trump. The Pentagon and US Space Force did not immediately respond to questions about whether the American military had imposed any restrictions on satellite communications services in Ukraine.Starlink is a crucial tool for Ukraine's military, supporting both offensive and defensive operations. The network is used for long-range drone missions, interceptor air-defence systems and frontline logistics, Beskrestnov said.“Obviously, this action cannot be a coincidence and is connected to the current political situation,” Beskrestnov said, without elaborating.The White House did not immediately comment.Kyiv received no warning before initial ballistic missile attackUkraine's air force spokesman Yurii Ihnat said Kyiv received no warning before an initial Russian ballistic missile attack on Tuesday night, although warnings were issued ahead of three subsequent waves of missiles.A lawmaker on Ukraine's parliamentary Defence Committee told The Associated Press that intelligence sharing with international partners had not stopped. The lawmaker spoke on condition of anonymity because they were not authorised to speak to the press.Five people were killed and 36 wounded in a Russian attack on Kyiv that lasted from Tuesday evening into Wednesday morning, police said.Russia continues strikes on Ukraine's power grid despite Trump's truce demandZelenskyy expressed outrage Wednesday over Russia's continued aerial bombardment of Ukraine's energy infrastructure, apparently defying Trump's call for a ceasefire.“We ask America and EVERYONE in the world who does not turn a blind eye to reality to respond — and to respond forcefully” to Russia's continued aerial attacks, Zelenskyy said in a social media post.“Russia has squandered the opportunity for de-escalation and has clearly chosen to continue its insane war of annihilation,” he said.Russian forces targeted Ukraine's power grid, oil facilities and gas infrastructure for a third consecutive night, Zelenskyy said. The attacks came after Trump claimed Russia and Ukraine had agreed not to target energy infrastructure, more than four years after Moscow launched its invasion.Meanwhile, Zelenskyy has agreed to halt Ukraine's months-long campaign against Russian oil refineries, which had caused fuel shortages in Russia.Ukraine's last widely reported strike on an oil refinery took place on Friday. Russian Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak accused Ukraine of attacking more refineries on Wednesday, but local officials and independent media did not report such attacks. Ukraine dismissed the allegation as false.Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said Wednesday that details of the energy ceasefire were still being worked out. “The work in that direction is continuing,” he told reporters.Russia's Defence Ministry said its forces had attacked Ukraine's energy infrastructure in Kyiv, the wider Kyiv region and the northeastern Kharkiv region overnight, striking six power plants.Russian forces struck all three of Kyiv's combined heat and power plants overnight into Wednesday, Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi said. At least 600,000 people were left without electricity, Zelenskyy said.Russia fired 39 ballistic missiles and more than 120 drones at energy and other infrastructure in Kyiv, the surrounding region and Kharkiv overnight, Zelenskyy said.Zelenskyy visits London to seek further supportZelenskyy arrived in London on Wednesday for talks with British Prime Minister Andy Burnham, who announced the accelerated delivery of British-made air-defence systems to Ukraine.Before their hour-long meeting at Downing Street, Burnham told Zelenskyy that Britain's support for Ukraine would remain unchanged, acknowledging that recent days had been “dark and difficult” for the country. Zelenskyy also met King Charles III at Buckingham Palace.European leaders remain concerned about Moscow's broader ambitions on the continent and have accused Russia of sabotage as part of a hybrid war. They are seeking to ensure Washington continues to support Kyiv.Ukraine claims battlefield gains against Russian forcesUkrainian officials said their forces were pushing back Russian troops in eastern Ukraine, where Moscow's larger army has been trying to make advances for years.Ukraine has recaptured 277 square kilometres (107 square miles) in an operation that began in the summer, said Brig Gen Andrii Biletskyi, commander of Ukraine's Third Army Corps, on Wednesday.The claim could not be independently verified, and Russian officials did not comment.Russia's defence ministry said its air defences had shot down 902 Ukrainian drones over several Russian regions, Crimea, which Moscow illegally annexed, and the waters of the Sea of Azov overnight.Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said 493 drones had flown towards the capital region. Most were intercepted far from the city, while 180 were shot down as they approached Moscow. He did not report any damage or casualties.Russian state-backed lender Sberbank confirmed that its data centre in Saratov had come under attack. The facility had once been planned as Europe's largest data centre.Russian state news agency Tass quoted a member of Sberbank's board as saying the bank's systems were operating normally.You use AI every day. articles.title: MUSTER   BY   OPEN   LIST !
articles.summary: There has been a buzz on board since morning ! A special routine has been promulgated and announced .
articles.body: There has been a buzz on board since morning ! A special routine has been promulgated and announced . Nobody has time to wait for anything and are on the move making themselves ready for the event . The haircut has been taken a day before , shoes polished , a relatively new uniform meant for special occasions has been washed and pressed a day early and is ready to be worn . Few stragglers have crowded around the ship’s Dhobi trying to search for their uniform; others are waiting in the Barber shop for ‘last minute touch up’! An early quick breakfast has been taken and the ship’s galley is busy preparing lunch . The deck has been cleaned and rust marks removed from the common areas . A shining new flag is flying on board and a smart look is seen of the ship from a distance . The married personnel are hurriedly walking up the gangway and will change into an ironed uniform on board . Our ship is not alone in this activity; all the ships , submarines and shore establishments in the station and the command and the Navy are focussed on the same activity . It is called ‘Muster by Open list’ !The announcement has been made for the Captain’s arrival who too has arrived a little before the scheduled arrival time. The ‘officer of the day’, Quarter master and Side boy are ready to receive the Captain as the Executive officer ( second in command ) rushes to take his post to receive him too on this special day . The captain's steward and coxswain are in attention and ready in front of his cabin to greet him and his new uniform with shining new stripes is hanging in his cabin , a new set of white shoes are also ready . As soon as the Captain lands on board and walks to his cabin the Quarter master sounds the pipe on the main broadcast and announces ‘out pipe’ and says –‘ Ship’s company assembles on Quarter deck for- Muster by Open list! ‘.Well! ‘Muster by Open list’ is conducted in the Indian Navy on the last day of each quarter by the Commanding officer personally in that he checks each person and his identity card in a parade where all the officers and men assemble on upper deck at a suitable place . The Captain stands behind a tall table in front of which the sequence of reports to be made by each sailor is written : personal number / Name /Rank / Ration /Married or Single. When all officers , senior sailors and junior sailors have assembled in separate platoons the Executive officer calls them to attention and then makes a report to the Captain ‘Ship’s company ready for ‘muster by open list Shriman’ . The Captain acknowledges the report and arrives to commence the proceedings . Prior to commencement of the proceedings the Executive officer again seeks his approval – ‘request permission to commence -Muster by Open List Shriman ‘ which the Captain approves by stating ‘Please’. Thereafter each sailor starting from senior-most to junior-most in a sequence promulgated before , run /march in front of the ‘Captain’s Table’ , stand in attention , salute and extend their right hand to right to clearly show their identity card clutched to the palm. As the sailor is rattling his particulars the Captain is confirming the same from the list in front of him and ticks his name and says ‘very good’ and the sailor pulls down his hand salutes and walks away relieved and retires to the mess.During my service I have observed with much admiration and amusement many a young junior sailor , dressed smartly in white half sleeve shirt and half pant , well polished boots and blue stockings run smartly with scary dilated eyes in front of the Captain , salute him and stutter or fumble the report even though they have been memorising it since a day before and the same is written in bold in front of them . Some Captains look smilingly some sternly and few ask them to repeat slowly and not to be scared of their first appearance . A standard report by a junior sailor who is unmarried and non vegetarian would run like this : Number 32567D, N Ram , Sea 1, S ( non veg ) ration , single Shriman!Not all pass muster clean! Many are checked for poor turn out , unpolished shoes , incorrect salute , torn identity card , faded photo, temporary identity card . The Divisional officer is standing on one side and he observes the identity card which the sailor flashes and makes note . There is a Gunnery instructor standing to observe the drill and some sailors are asked to wait and later are either admonished or asked to report for drill to correct their salute etc. All the observations regarding the identity card are being noted down by the Regulating staff such as being old, faded ,torn , temporary etc . Observations on turn out and drill are being noted by the Gunnery instructor . The atmosphere is tense and all wish it to complete soon . Even some experienced and very senior sailors freeze or forget their lines repeated on so many occasions during their career when they stand in front of the Commanding officer .Probably , they get so overwhelmed by the seriousness of the occasion! The most relieving thing is that it does not last long and has no after effects.The time taken to complete the exercise ranges from thirty minutes to three hours or even more . This depends on the size of the ship and the strength of the ship’s company ranging from a crew of 50 of the missile boat to about 1500 of the aircraft carrier. Over the years the system has been modified and the Commanding officer of Aircraft carrier checks the identity cards of only the Master Chief Petty Officers ( Subedar Major) and the rest are by the various Heads of department . Those who miss the muster on account of being on duty have a ‘Mismuster’ in the afternoon taken by the Executive officer. The identity cards of the officers are checked and verified by Regulating staff on a register which is signed by both. A detailed report is rendered to the Command Headquarters and follow-up action on anomalies and temporary identity cards is initiated.Well ! An outsider observing the above may wonder what was all the fuss about! The entire exercise could be done by digital means very quickly . Indeed quite relevant , however the purpose of the exercise is beyond the routine verification of identity cards. The exercise instils discipline , method , order , system , meticulousness and above all Regimentation - the ‘Hall mark’ of the Armed Forces. It gives the Leader a first hand human picture of his ship , the men he commands , the force that shall deliver.The ceremonies and rituals play a very important part in our lives in binding us with our family , our ‘Kutumb’ be they religious or celebratory . These restore and reinforce the family , community , village values . Their repetitiveness and regularity reiterates and reinforces our beliefs . The ‘Muster by Open List ‘ has the same purpose: invisible and potent.Often recollection of ‘Muster by Open list’ makes me smile and I tell myself that the crux of the Navy is ‘S’ ration single Shriman!Disclaimer: Views expressed above are the author's own.

articles.title: Netflix lays off 1,000 employees: Former staff flood LinkedIn with support, job offers and referrals
articles.summary: Netflix, the streaming platform giant, is cutting jobs by 6%.
articles.body: Netflix, the streaming platform giant, is cutting jobs by 6%. Co-CEOs Greg Peters and Ted Sarandos told employees in an email that about 1,000 people in the company’s global workforce will lose their jobs, according to a Wall Street Journal report.It’s the company’s biggest round of layoffs since 2022, and it comes as the world’s largest streaming service finds it harder to grow.Big companies often get described in numbers, such as headcounts, percentages, and share prices. But for the people affected, this is much more than a business story, as behind the numbers are colleagues, families, and plans that depend upon it.Social media platforms have been flooded with former Netflix employees weighing in with sympathetic posts for those who lost their jobs in this layoff.Netflix cuts jobs by 6% of its global workforceNetflix has announced one of its biggest rounds of job cuts in years. Co-CEOs Ted Sarandos and Greg Peters announced the cuts in an internal email on October 14, 2026. Roughly 1,000 people, about 6% of the workforce, are affected, making it the largest staff reduction since 2022The job cuts are not spread evenly across a particular vertical; as per the announcement, most of them will be centered around the product, technology, legal, and human resources teams. In the memo, the leaders wrote, according to the Hollywood Reporter, “Decisions like these are never easy, and we don’t take them lightly.”The layoffs follow months of worry about Netflix’s growthSarandos told a Bloomberg conference last month, “We’re not growing as fast as I want us to.” According to its latest quarterly earnings report, viewers watched more than 97 billion hours of content in the first half of 2026. That’s only about 2% more than the same period last year, which is a fairly small increase for a company of its size.Social media gets flooded with supportive messages from former Netflix employeesWhile the business side was being discussed, a different conversation unfolded on LinkedIn. Several former Netflix employees posted messages of support, and many offered practical help.One former employee reminded colleagues, in a LinkedIn post, "Thinking of all my former colleagues at Netflix today. Layoffs are never easy, and they’re especially tough when you have to leave an amazing organization. But keep your heads up - there’s life after Netflix. You got this!".Another Netflix alum added, "To all my old Netflix friends, I hope the layoffs haven’t affected you. But if they have, just remember it’s going to be okay. It’s a big world out there and you’ll land on your feet. Our line of work isn’t dying. It’s just changing. Feel free to reach out for a chat if you need one."Another added, "To everyone impacted by todays layoffs at Netflix, my heart goes out to you. As a Netflix alum who has also experienced being laid off, I know firsthand how difficult this moment can be. The uncertainty, emotions, and questions about whats next are real.But I also know this: A layoff doesnt define your talent, your worth, or your future. Netflix is home to some of the most talented people Ive ever worked with, and I know incredible opportunities lie ahead for many of you. If there's anything I can do to help, please reach out. And if you're a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, or Data Scientist, please DM me directly. I'd love to explore opportunities and see if we can find a great fit for you. I've been in your shoes, and I know how much a helping hand can mean."Another user took to their profile and wrote, "Thinking of everyone who is impacted because of the layoffs. Today was a hard day for Netflix. Some of the most brilliant people I've ever worked with were impacted by the layoffs. I know it's easy for me to say this from where I stand, and I won't pretend to know how you feel right now. But I want you to hear it anyway: you are absolute rockstars.Truly some of the best engineers and teammates in the industry. You raised the bar every single day, shipped work that millions of people use, and made everyone around you better. This says nothing about your talent or your worth. Whoever gets you next is getting a gift. If you're hiring, look no further. And to my friends who were affected, I'm happy to make intros, write referrals, review resumes, or just talk. Thank you for everything. Rooting for you always. 💙"Another user offered help writing on LinkedIn, “Thinking of all my old friends and colleagues amid the #Netflix layoff news today. Here to help however I can! Resume reviews, soundboarding ideas, referrals or recruiter connections. Please don’t hesitate to reach out. This is only the beginning! "Get the latest movie news, reviews, and celebrity updates. Download the TOI App.

articles.title: Engineering a cheaper way to play videogames
articles.summary: On a table in Arc’s Bengaluru lab, a gaming device sits attached to cardboard, its electronics exposed.
articles.body: On a table in Arc’s Bengaluru lab, a gaming device sits attached to cardboard, its electronics exposed. It is an engineering prototype, waiting to be tested before being fitted into a proper case. During a video interview, cofounder Kaustubh K Jadhav lifts it towards the camera. This is device number 007, one of roughly 40 prototypes through which a young team is trying to answer a difficult question: can more Indians afford to play games beyond their smartphones?The answer, Arc believes, lies as much in software as in the machine itself. Its Rs 33,500 X1 handheld is being built around a relatively affordable, power-efficient processor, with engineers working to make games designed for other computers run on it.“Hardware was not the only thing that needed solving. The software systems were essential too,” says Jadhav. “Our attempt was to make a device optimised for the gaming requirements of somebody coming out of India, and primarily emerging markets.”Jadhav’s route into gaming hardware came through running and backing gaming businesses. He was previously co founder and chief operating officer of GameEon Studios, a game development company, and a partner at SyndiCap Venture Partners. “As a VC I set up a gaming fund out of India,” he says. He and cofounder Jobin Joseph have spent roughly four years working professionally in gaming, drawing on conversations with PC and handheld gamers to shape Arc’s approach. Their industry experience is complemented by a team whose skills span open-source software and aerospace engineering.The price barrier that Arc is trying to abolish is considerable. Sony’s PlayStation 5 Digital Edition will set an Indian gamer back Rs 64,990, before the cost of games or a screen. A title such as the upcoming GTA VI costs another Rs 5,999. For a household weighing gaming against other expenses, the machine is only the first bill. A handheld gaming device, like the one Arc is making, can easily cost double what Arc is charging as well.Architecting from scratchArc’s engineering effort begins with the processor. The X1 uses Qualcomm’s Snapdragon G2 Gen 2, designed for handheld gaming and based on ARM, a family of chip designs also found in smartphones. Many gaming computers use a different architecture, called x86. Architecture is essentially the set of instructions a processor understands.Jadhav says cost and battery life pushed the team towards ARM. “We could not build an x86 project because of the price, power management and battery life,” he says.But choosing the chip is only the beginning. Games written for a Windows PC cannot simply be dropped onto an Android-based handheld and expected to work. The software and processor speak different languages. Bridging that gap is where much of Arc’s effort goes.The team has built its own operating system, OwlOS, using the Android Open Source Project. This gives engineers an established starting point, while allowing them to change how the system handles games, controls and performance.Jadhav says it also integrates Proton, software that helps Windows games work on Linux, another operating system. Such a compatibility layer acts like an interpreter. Running PC games on ARM requires handling differences in processor instructions too, making compatibility an engineering task rather than a switch that can simply be turned on.“The last game we pushed out was GTA V. We were doing a sustained frame rate of around 30 to 35,” says Jadhav. Frame rate measures how many images appear each second, influencing how smoothly a game moves.Red Dead Redemption 2, a demanding game set in the American frontier, is another target. Each additional game title brings work on getting it running, improving performance and checking stability.“It is not a sprint, it is primarily a marathon,” says Jadhav. “We will spend time building something, testing it out, stabilising it.”Behind that effort is a 14-member team, including 11 engineers. Arc’s average employee age is 25. Some come from communities that develop open-source software. Others have worked in aerospace engineering, bringing experience in miniaturisation — fitting working systems into confined spaces.Jadhav says so far the device has passed through eight or nine iterations covering physical design, architecture and software. Around 50 testers have contributed feedback. Changes to major functions or the design trigger another round of testing.The work also extends to components players touch and feel. Jadhav says Arc has custom-designed its seven-inch screen, trigger buttons and vibration feedback.“The complete product design is in-house,” he says. Manufacturing draws on suppliers in India, Taiwan and elsewhere in Southeast Asia. “Certain parts can be manufactured in India. Certain parts cannot.”Affordability imposes limits. Jadhav says memory prices have complicated costs, and Arc is taking no margin at the stated price. More demanding games would use cloud services, with remote computers doing the processing, bringing internet and subscription costs.Deliveries are planned for early 2027. The team’s immediate task is to turn those exposed prototypes into reliable machines. “I would have loved to get it much lower. But as a small company, we have our limitations.”His longer ambition is to gather enough paying gamers to negotiate better Indian pricing for games and services.Our attempt is to build a gaming device for India and emerging markets. Hardware is not the only thing we need to solve; software is essential too. The goal is to get more devices into more hands, bring more games into the ecosystem and push for regional pricing. Over time, we want our engineering work to help build something different from what we have seen in the West so far. — Kaustubh K Jadhav, Cofounder, ArcYou use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. articles.title: Applying AI to real-world problems
articles.summary: The team of Abhiram Ramachandran, Madiha Ahmed and Polisetti Likhit Sai from IIT Hyderabad won the recently concluded Accenture Innovation Challenge.
articles.body: The team of Abhiram Ramachandran, Madiha Ahmed and Polisetti Likhit Sai from IIT Hyderabad won the recently concluded Accenture Innovation Challenge. They developed a gen AI-powered business intelligence solution that analyses business data to identify root causes of declining performance, helping organisations understand what went wrong, and how to address it. They received prizes worth Rs 3 lakh.The first runner-up was the team of Astha Jaiswal, Aayushi Bhardwaj and Siddha Mishra from IIT Roorkee, which developed an AI-powered manufacturing intelligence platform with a real-time digital twin, using live production data, sensor inputs, computer vision, and digital simulations. Specialist AI agents monitor operations, identify potential issues, and assess repair options, helping manufacturers anticipate defects and take corrective action.The second runner-up was the team of Tejas Goyal, Prakhar Agarwal and Shiwang Gupta from IIT Delhi, which developed an AI-powered clinical decision-support system that helps emergency care teams prioritise patients based on the risks of waiting, while ensuring clinical judgment remains with healthcare professionals.The Accenture competition for STEM students in India is now in its eleventh edition, and drew over 5,000 registrations from 20 IITs and NITs this year.You use AI every day. articles.title: Texas approved a reservoir that could flood more than 16,000 acres of ranchland; after years of landowner opposition, a judge has overturned the permit, though Wichita Falls can still appeal
articles.summary: A Texas judge has overturned a state-issued permit for the proposed Lake Ringgold reservoir, handing a significant victory to ranchers and conservation
articles.body: A Texas judge has overturned a state-issued permit for the proposed Lake Ringgold reservoir, handing a significant victory to ranchers and conservation groups that have spent years challenging the project. The ruling, delivered by Travis County District Judge Maya Guerra Gamble on October 8, 2026, puts a major obstacle in the path of a reservoir intended to strengthen water supplies for Wichita Falls and the surrounding region. According to reporting by KAUZ News Channel 6 and statements from the Texas & Southwestern Cattle Raisers Association and Texas Conservation Alliance, the proposed project in Clay County could inundate more than 16,000 acres of agricultural land and wildlife habitat. The City of Wichita Falls, however, has indicated that it remains committed to the reservoir and has the option to appeal the decision.Why the Lake Ringgold project faced oppositionThe proposed reservoir has been promoted as a long-term solution to water security concerns in North Texas, where drought and growing demand have intensified the need for reliable supplies. City officials have argued that developing additional water resources is essential to preparing the region for future shortages.For ranchers and conservationists, however, the project’s potential costs extend well beyond the construction of a new reservoir. The planned lake could submerge productive grazing land, disrupt established ranching operations and permanently transform parts of the Little Wichita River corridor.The Texas Conservation Alliance has also raised concerns about the loss of native tallgrass prairie and wildlife habitat. Opponents argue that a project of this scale must be supported by a clear demonstration of water demand and a thorough assessment of alternative ways to meet it. Landowners challenged the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality’s approval of the reservoir permit, seeking judicial review of the decision and the justification for the project.Judge overturns the reservoir permitThe latest ruling reverses the environmental regulator’s earlier decision to issue the permit, marking a major development in the long-running dispute. The Texas & Southwestern Cattle Raisers Association welcomed the outcome, describing it as an important milestone for private property rights and the protection of agricultural land. The association had supported affected landowners throughout the legal process.Texas Conservation Alliance also backed the challenge, arguing that responsible water planning must balance future supply requirements with environmental protection and the interests of people whose livelihoods depend on the land. The ruling does not necessarily end the Lake Ringgold proposal. Instead, it leaves the project facing a legal setback that could delay its progress while the city considers its next steps.Wichita Falls keeps its options openWichita Falls has maintained that Lake Ringgold remains an important part of its long-term water strategy. Following the ruling, Mayor Tim Short told KAUZ that the city had 30 days to appeal and would discuss how to proceed over the coming weeks. The city’s public works director, Russell Schreiber, also indicated that the latest development was one stage in a longer permitting and construction process. Officials continue to point to the drought conditions that initially prompted the proposal as a reason to pursue additional water infrastructure. An appeal could prolong the dispute, leaving landowners uncertain about the future of their properties and the city facing further delays in its efforts to secure water supplies.A wider debate over water security and property rightsThe Lake Ringgold case reflects a recurring challenge in Texas: how to expand water infrastructure while protecting private land, agricultural livelihoods and ecologically sensitive areas.Reservoirs can provide important safeguards against drought, but large projects can also require substantial land acquisition and alter landscapes for generations. For affected ranchers, the potential loss of thousands of acres raises questions about the long-term consequences of prioritising water storage over existing land uses.The legal challenge has placed those competing interests under scrutiny, with landowners arguing that the need for additional water must be weighed against the project’s environmental and economic costs. For now, Judge Gamble’s decision has halted the permit’s progress. Whether the ruling ultimately ends the Lake Ringgold proposal or leads to another round of litigation will depend on the city’s next move and the legal proceedings that followYou use AI every day.
